# Load datasets
reservation_data <- read_dta("data/reservation_data_merged_id_complete.dta")
intra_island_distance <- read.csv("data/intra_island_distance2.csv")

# Add year
reservation_data$year <- as.numeric(format(as.Date(reservation_data$CheckinDate, "%Y-%m-%d"), "%Y"))

reservation_data <- reservation_data %>%
  mutate(zip = ifelse(zip == 96812, 96813, zip))

# Group and compute yearly averages
avg_days_per_year <- reservation_data %>%
  group_by(year, id) %>%
  summarize(avg_days_visited = mean(days_visited, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

avg_days_2018 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2018)
avg_days_2019 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2019)
avg_days_2020 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2020)
avg_days_2021 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2021)
avg_days_2022 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2022)
avg_days_2023 <- avg_days_per_year %>% filter(year == 2023)


# Function to process data for a single year
process_year <- function(year_input) {
  data_year <- reservation_data %>% filter(year == year_input)
  
  unique_visits <- data_year %>%
    filter(!is.na(CheckinDate)) %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, CheckinDate) %>%
    group_by(id, parkname) %>%
    summarize(VisitCount = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  all_combinations <- expand.grid(
    id = unique(data_year$id),
    parkname = unique(data_year$parkname),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  visit_data <- all_combinations %>%
    left_join(unique_visits, by = c("id", "parkname")) %>%
    mutate(VisitCount = ifelse(is.na(VisitCount), 0, VisitCount))
  
  person_info <- data_year %>%
    select(id, Permittee, zip, Zip, NoOfGuests, days_visited, year) %>%
    distinct()
  
  long_resdata_count <- left_join(visit_data, person_info, by = "id")
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count %>%
    mutate(island_park = case_when(
      parkname == "Ainapo Cabin" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Hipalau" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Kaluahaulu" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Kamananui Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kaunala Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kawaikoi" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Keanakolu Ranger & Bunkhouse Cabins" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Kuaokala Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kulanaahane Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Kuliouou Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Lonomea" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Maakua Ridge Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Manana Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Peacock Flats Campsite" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Sugi Grove" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waialae Cabin Campsite" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waikoali" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Waikolu" ~ "Molokai",
      parkname == "Waimano Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      parkname == "Waimanu Campsite" ~ "Hawaii",
      parkname == "Wiliwili" ~ "Kauai",
      parkname == "Wiliwilinui Ridge Trail" ~ "Oahu",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count[order(long_resdata_count$id, long_resdata_count$parkname), ]
  long_resdata_count$parkname_numeric <- as.integer(factor(long_resdata_count$parkname, levels = unique(long_resdata_count$parkname)))
  
  long_resdata_count <- long_resdata_count %>%
    distinct(id, parkname, .keep_all = TRUE)
  
  final_data <- long_resdata_count %>%
    left_join(
      intra_island_distance %>%
        select(zip, parkname, income, residents_distance_meters, residents_duration, island_live),
      by = c("zip", "parkname")
    )
  
  final_data <- final_data %>%
    group_by(id) %>%
    mutate(visited_another_island = ifelse(any(island_park != island_live & VisitCount > 0), 1, 0)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  final_data$travel_distance_km <- (final_data$residents_distance_meters / 1000) * 2
  
  
  return(final_data)
}

Satiation multiply every translation parameter (gamma) by 2, and by 4 (doubling twice). Uses the previous data from mdcev_model_list

# Satiation multiply every translation parameter (gamma) by 2, and by 4 (doubling twice).


stopifnot(all(c("n_psi", "n_gamma") %in% names(mdcev_model_list[["2018"]]$parms_info$n_vars)))

YEARS       <- 2018:2023        # start with 2018, then widen

scale_gamma <- function(mle_obj, multiplier) {
  n_psi   <- mle_obj$parms_info$n_vars$n_psi
  n_gamma <- mle_obj$parms_info$n_vars$n_gamma
  gamma_cols <- (n_psi + 1):(n_psi + n_gamma)

  orig_gamma <- as.numeric(mle_obj$stan_fit$par$gamma)
  new_gamma  <- orig_gamma * multiplier

  out <- mle_obj
  out$stan_fit$par$gamma[1, ] <- new_gamma
  out$stan_fit$theta_tilde[, gamma_cols] <-
    matrix(new_gamma, nrow = nrow(out$stan_fit$theta_tilde),
           ncol = length(new_gamma), byrow = TRUE)
  out
}

## give each trip a week, at most one trip per week. pref = preferred (calendar) week, whose week is taken goes to the nearest free week (the earlier one on a tie). Undated trips go to the first free week.

assign_weeks <- function(pref) {
  n <- length(pref)
  if (n > 52) stop("a camper has more than 52 trips; cannot place one trip per week")
  out <- rep(NA_integer_, n); used <- logical(52)
  for (k in order(is.na(pref), pref)) {
    w <- if (is.na(pref[k])) 1L else as.integer(pref[k])
    if (used[w]) { free <- which(!used); w <- free[which.min(abs(free - w))] }
    out[k] <- w; used[w] <- TRUE
  }
  out
}

  df_52_weeks <- unique_users %>%
    expand_grid(week = 1:52) %>%
    mutate(choice_id = paste0(id, "_w", week))
 
  weekly_panel <- df_52_weeks %>%
    left_join(trips %>% select(id, week, chosen_park = parkname), by = c("id", "week")) %>%
    mutate(chosen_park = replace_na(chosen_park, "Stay_Home"))
  stopifnot(nrow(weekly_panel) == nrow(df_52_weeks))
 
  assign(paste0("final_data_", yr, "_rum"), weekly_panel, envir = .GlobalEnv)
 
  # --- Build the full choice set (one row per person-week-alternative) ---
  df_rum_final <- weekly_panel %>%
    expand_grid(parkname = c(all_parks, "Stay_Home")) %>%
    mutate(choice = (chosen_park == parkname)) %>%
    left_join(current_data %>% mutate(id = as.character(id)) %>% select(id, parkname, price),
              by = c("id", "parkname")) %>%
    mutate(price = ifelse(parkname == "Stay_Home", 0, price))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(df_rum_final$price))
 
  df_idx_local <- dfidx(df_rum_final, idx = list("choice_id", "parkname"), shape = "long")
 
  ##  Stay_Home is the reference alternative (its constant is fixed at 0)
  rum_mle_52 <- tryCatch({
    mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home", method = "nr")
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("NR Solver failed, trying BHHH...")
    mlogit(choice ~ price | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home", method = "bhhh")
  })
 
  model_list_52[[paste("52wk", yr)]] <<- rum_mle_52
 
  rum_null <- mlogit(choice ~ 1 | 1, data = df_idx_local, reflevel = "Stay_Home")
  ll_mod  <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_mle_52))
  ll_null <- as.numeric(logLik(rum_null))
  mcf_r2  <- 1 - (ll_mod / ll_null)
  mcfadden_list_52[[paste("52weeks", yr)]] <<- format(round(mcf_r2, 3), nsmall = 3)
 
  # --- CHANGED: welfare from one occasion per camper ----------------------
  X   <- model.matrix(rum_mle_52)
  oid <- as.character(idx(df_idx_local, 1)); alt <- as.character(idx(df_idx_local, 2))
  alts <- unique(alt); K <- length(alts)
  stopifnot(nrow(X) == length(oid), all(alt == rep(alts, length(unique(oid)))))
  first <- grepl("_w1$", oid) # week 1 of every camper
  X1    <- X[first, , drop = FALSE]
  pid   <- sub("_w1$", "", oid[first][seq(1, sum(first), by = K)])
  sites <- sort(all_parks)
  site_cols <- match(sites, alts); home_col <- match("Stay_Home", alts)
  stopifnot(!anyNA(site_cols), !is.na(home_col))
 
  ## annual losses per camper (campers x policies) for coefficient vector b
  person_loss <- function(b) {
    V  <- matrix(X1 %*% b[colnames(X1)], ncol = K, byrow = TRUE)
    P  <- exp(V - apply(V, 1, max)); P <- P / rowSums(P)
    bp <- -b[["price"]]
    L  <- 52 * log(1 - P[, site_cols, drop = FALSE]) / bp        # close one site
    colnames(L) <- sites
    cbind(L, "All sites closed" = 52 * log(P[, home_col]) / bp)  # only Stay_Home left
  }
  ## means per camper
  welf_summary <- function(b) {
    L <- person_loss(b); site <- L[, sites, drop = FALSE]
    c(colMeans(site),
      "Sum of single-site losses" = mean(rowSums(site)),
      "All sites closed"          = mean(L[, "All sites closed"]),
      "Average site closure"      = mean(colMeans(site)))
  }
 
  # ---  Krinsky-Robb ----------------------------------------------
  set.seed(898989 + yr)                                      
  draws <- MASS::mvrnorm(N_KR, coef(rum_mle_52), vcov(rum_mle_52))  
  kr <- t(apply(draws, 1, welf_summary))
  pt <- welf_summary(coef(rum_mle_52))
  kr_summary <- data.frame(measure = names(pt), mean = pt,
                           lower = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.025),
                           upper = apply(kr, 2, quantile, 0.975),
                           row.names = NULL)
  kr_list_52[[paste("52wk", yr)]] <<- list(summary = kr_summary, draws = kr)
  print(kr_summary, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
 
  # --- per-person point estimates (same output as before) -----------------
  Lp <- person_loss(coef(rum_mle_52))
  rum_person_results <- data.frame(
    id              = rep(pid, ncol(Lp)),
    annual_rum_loss = as.vector(Lp),
    parkname        = rep(colnames(Lp), each = nrow(Lp))
  )
 
  year_comparison <- rum_person_results %>%
    left_join(unique_users, by = "id") %>%
    mutate(year = yr)
 
  return(year_comparison)
})
